sources.fact: Cancellation can fail if allocation callback already ran or is about to run. Successful cancellation means no resource allocation and no execution callback.
sources.model_limit: Cancel only requests cancellation; ResolveNoResource is a trusted simulated provider event, not an OS result. No concurrency or IRQL validation.

sources.fact: The classic scatter/gather flow has an explicit cleanup routine, including transfer direction.
sources.model_limit: Opaque mock Put only checks exact-once lifetime and saved direction; no DMA API is called.

sources.fact: Documentation describes automatic resource release after the allocation callback returns; synchronous mode without callback requires explicit FreeAdapterObject cleanup.
sources.model_limit: Do not equate this retained-cookie model with GetScatterGatherListEx callback semantics. Real Windows transport not selected.
